name: Washington SQ Center
summary: Washington Square Center is a Brixmor-managed shopping center serving Kaufman, Texas with convenient retail and service options. With a 4.1-star rating from over 350 reviews, it provides accessible shopping along South Washington Street for the local community.
demographics: Washington Square Center serves the Kaufman, Texas community, drawing primarily from middle-income families and working professionals in this growing suburban area east of Dallas. The trade area consists largely of homeowners aged 30-65 with household incomes in the $50,000-$80,000 range, reflecting Kaufman's role as an affordable bedroom community. Shoppers typically visit for convenience-oriented needs and everyday services, with strong preference for value-focused retailers and local businesses that serve the daily needs of this family-oriented market.
description: Washington Square Center is a neighborhood shopping destination located at 2005 South Washington Street in Kaufman, Texas, serving the local community with convenient retail and service options. Managed by Brixmor Property Group, one of the nation's leading owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, this center provides essential shopping and services to residents of Kaufman and surrounding areas in the eastern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The center maintains regular operating hours from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, making it accessible for both early morning and evening shoppers. With a solid 4.1-star rating from over 350 Google reviews, Washington Square Center has established itself as a reliable community gathering place. Its location on South Washington Street positions it along a major thoroughfare, offering easy access and visibility for the growing Kaufman community.
